component.name: Tether
component.summary: Humane Flowmodoro, focus soundscapes, and cognitive companion for deep work

description.p: Tether is an unbreakable Flowmodoro timer, focus soundscape player, and cognitive companion designed for deep work, knowledge workers, creators, students, and professionals—crafted with universal design principles that empower neurodivergent minds (ADHD, Autism, Dyslexia) and anyone seeking calm, sustainable, guilt-free productivity.

Instead of rigid countdown alarms that shatter concentration, Tether counts UP to ride your natural flow state and calculates proportional rest periods when you finish. It includes offline acoustic focus soundscapes (Brown, Pink, Green noise, 40 Hz Gamma, and authentic nature field recordings), a rapid RAM-dump impulse buffer to park side-thoughts instantly, and seamless save-state context anchoring with optional Neovim and VS Code integration.
Major feature release introducing Fartsdump (Soft Interceptor) to protect ADHD deep flow.

ul.li: Real-time background distraction detection during active focus sessions.
Dedicated centered desktop prompt (org.tether.Speedbump) appearing directly on the active workspace.
Quick 1-key actions: "Parkér som impuls" (Enter) to auto-save rabbit holes and refocus editor, "Dette er relevant" (Esc) to snooze, and "Ta pause nå" to bank and take break.
Customizable distraction triggers list, cooldown duration, and master toggle in the Settings tab.

description.p: User interface polish, calm typography, and dedicated focus soundscape section.

ul.li: Added dedicated group header and description for the focus soundscape controls.
Replaced raw unicode emojis across buttons, headers, dialogs, and badges with clean, professional typography and symbolic vector icons in line with GNOME HIG and Calm Design.
Refined action button labels, context anchor rows, momentum tiers, and editor connection status indicators.

description.p: Feature release with focus soundscapes, volume popover, interactive checkboxes, retention cleanup, and platform-agnostic focus tracking.

ul.li: Procedural offline focus soundscapes (Brown noise, Pink noise, Gentle rain) with auto-play and fade-down.
Interactive in-row sound controls with play/pause toggle and flush-right volume popover.
Interactive markdown checkboxes for captured impulses with customizable retention pruning.
Platform-agnostic editor focus synchronization across Neovim, VS Code, and desktop.
Dynamic content-driven window sizing without vertical scrolling on the Flow tab.
Gentle focus chime and break gong notifications.

description.p: Added pause banking on early break termination, per-editor minimize settings, and auto-maximize on break.
Initial release of Tether desktop companion.
